final: WITH phase_stats AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_usage, COUNT(*) AS phase_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), phase_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_usage) AS mean_usage FROM phase_stats) SELECT AVG(p.avg_usage) AS average_bandwidth, SUM(p.phase_count) AS total_count, AVG(p.avg_usage - m.mean_usage) AS average_excess FROM phase_stats AS p CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m WHERE p.avg_usage > m.mean_usage
